<?php
$value = $_GET['filter'];

class DependencyDao
{
    public function getFilterRequiresByPath($value)
    {
        $query = "SELECT id, type FROM (
            SELECT d.targetid as id FROM dependencies d
            INNER JOIN objects o ON o.id = d.targetid
            WHERE LOWER(CONCAT(o.path, o.key)) RLIKE '" . $value . "'
        ) dep ORDER BY id ASC";
        return $this->db->fetchAllAssociative($query);
    }
}
